skill.name: analyzing-products
skill.description: Analyzes an e-commerce URL or product photo to produce factual product details, usage mechanics, visual features, and curated reference images.
skill.summary: Turn product pages or photos into consistent facts and generation-ready visual references.
skill.author: supercmohq

security_audit.summary: All eight static findings are false positives caused by ordinary prose, Markdown code spans, or browser version tokens in a user-agent string. URL mode still presents a medium-risk server-side request forgery concern because it downloads extractor-provided URLs without documented destination validation.

remediation.issue: Extractor-provided image URLs are downloaded with redirects and no documented destination validation.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only HTTPS image URLs, resolve and reject private or local addresses, revalidate every redirect, and enforce response size and content-type limits.

content.user_title: Analyze Products from URLs or Photos
content.value_statement: Product pages and photos often lack structured facts for reliable creative generation. This skill extracts product details, usage mechanics, visual features, and reference images.
actual_capabilities: Extracts product names, brands, variants, specifications, features, and image URLs from e-commerce pages.
Downloads and filters up to ten candidate images, then returns up to five suitable references.
Identifies precise product categories and real-world usage from a supplied photo.
Describes moving parts, opening sequences, controls, materials, labels, colors, and distinctive features.
Produces a factual two-paragraph description for downstream image or video generation.
limitations: URL analysis requires the url_extraction tool and network access.
Photo analysis requires the image_analysis tool and a clear, sufficiently detailed image.
The skill does not rank market position or infer unsupported product mechanics.
Image filtering can remove every candidate when photos contain faces, wrong variants, or unsuitable layouts.

use_cases.title: Prepare Campaign References
use_cases.description: Turn a product listing into a concise description and curated images for campaign asset generation.

use_cases.title: Document Product Mechanics
use_cases.description: Analyze a photo to describe how a product opens, moves, and is used.

use_cases.title: Normalize Catalog Inputs
use_cases.description: Convert varied store pages into consistent product facts for downstream creative workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Product Photo
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this product photo. Identify the exact category, usage, moving parts, materials, colors, labels, and distinctive visual details.

prompt_templates.title: Extract a Product Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this product URL: [URL]. Return a factual description and up to five clean images matching the selected variant.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Generation Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [URL or photo] for [campaign format]. Emphasize dimensions, materials, operation, variant details, and visual features that must remain consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Source Consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this listing [URL] and attached photo. Treat the listing as primary, flag visible conflicts, and produce a generation-ready product brief.

output_examples.input: A clear photo of a matte black insulated bottle with a loop cap.
output_examples.output: Category: vacuum-insulated reusable bottle. Use: twist off the loop cap, fill, reseal, and carry. Preserve the matte finish, cylindrical shape, cap loop, and printed logo.

output_examples.input: An e-commerce URL for wireless over-ear headphones in the selected silver variant.
output: A factual description covering brand, fit, controls, connectivity, battery details, materials, and intended user.
Up to five local image paths for clean silver product shots without faces or conflicting variants.

best_practices: Provide the selected variant when a listing offers multiple colors, sizes, or configurations.
Use clear, uncropped photos that show labels, controls, closures, and distinctive features.
Verify extracted specifications against the visible product before using them in generation.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent hidden mechanics or unreadable specifications.
Do not use lifestyle photos with obscured products as the only visual source.
Do not treat the output as a market ranking, review summary, or purchasing recommendation.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill accept?
faq.answer: It accepts an e-commerce product URL, a product photo, or both.

faq.question: What happens when both a URL and photo are provided?
faq.answer: It uses URL mode for richer details and keeps the photo as an additional reference.

faq.question: How many images can it return?
faq.answer: It evaluates up to ten candidates and returns up to five suitable product images.

faq.question: Which images does it reject?
faq.answer: It rejects faces, lifestyle shots, review images, banners, logos, size charts, and conflicting variants.

faq.question: Can it analyze a blurry or cropped photo?
faq.answer: It reports uncertain details and requests a clearer photo instead of guessing.

faq.question: Does it create final images or videos?
faq.answer: No. It prepares product facts and references for downstream image or video generation.
